parents.subject: African American Studies
parents.course: Introduction to Health and Wellness in the Black Community

ns2:section.sectionText: An introduction for understanding health-related issues and disparities affecting the African American community. We will explore health status across the lifespan, social and environmental challenges, chronic diseases, lifestyle behaviors, and intervention, research and policy implications. Students will learn how to integrate and situate these complexities in a broader systemic framework and understand how this population exhibits resiliency in the face of these adversities. No late enrollment after the first day of class.
